deferred.claim: Cast Winternight Stories normally; draw three cards, then discard two cards unless discarding a creature card.
deferred.basis: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a creature card.

deferred.claim: Cast Winternight Stories from your graveyard for its harmonize cost, optionally tapping a creature you control to reduce the cost by its power; perform the draw and discard effect and exile the spell.
deferred.basis: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a creature card. ... Harmonize {4}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its harmonize cost. You may tap a creature you control to reduce that cost by {X}, where X is its power. Then exile this spell.)
